items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Hope's on the economy. They mostly gave him bode-grab balls though... The interviewee does not respond to the mention of Hope.

ctx.x: No, you did. That was the main hall. Yeah.
Hope's on the economy. They mostly gave him bode-grab balls though, you know? The real people didn't go there. The aristocratic people didn't go there. It was just the low-class people.
You know, the lawn showman's all burned just before Christmas.
